categories.main_business_segments: Sinolong New Materials Co., Ltd. primarily focuses on the research, production, and sales of functional BOPA films, biodegradable BOPLA films, and polyamide 6 (PA6) materials. The company operates mainly in the manufacturing of plastic films, serving industries such as food and beverage packaging, daily chemicals, pharmaceuticals, and soft-pack lithium batteries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced biaxial stretching technologies including stepwise stretching, mechanical synchronous stretching, and magnetic levitation linear synchronous stretching (LISIM). It has proprietary technologies for masterbatch dispersion, multi-layer co-extrusion, and special coatings to enhance film properties such as barrier performance, heat sealability, and antimicrobial effects. The production process integrates upstream PA6 polymerization with downstream film stretching, ensuring quality and cost advantages.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major food and beverage brands, pharmaceutical companies, daily chemical product manufacturers, and lithium battery producers. The company supplies packaging materials for fresh food, ready meals, pet food, cosmetics, medical blister packs, and soft-pack lithium batteries, serving both domestic and international markets with a focus on high-end and customized applications.
categories.geographic_coverage: Sinolong operates production bases in China (Xiamen and Quanzhou) and Indonesia, serving over 40 countries across five continents including North America, Europe, Asia, Africa, and Oceania. The company is expanding its overseas capacity to better serve Southeast Asian and global markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates an integrated upstream to downstream supply chain, producing PA6 resin (upstream) and functional BOPA/BOPLA films (midstream to downstream). This vertical integration enhances supply stability, cost control, and collaborative R&D across the polymer and film production stages.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Sinolong emphasizes sustainable development and innovation, focusing on expanding its product portfolio with eco-friendly and high-performance films. Key R&D projects include high-temperature nylon variants, low-carbon high-strength biaxially stretched polyamide films, lithium battery packaging films, and biodegradable PLA films. The company pursues continuous process optimization, new material development, and customized solutions to meet evolving market demands and environmental regulations.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through direct sales of its functional films and PA6 materials. Sales are conducted via direct sales and distribution channels, with a significant portion of revenue from exports. The revenue is recognized upon transfer of control of goods to customers, mainly at a point in time.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Sinolong is the global leader in the functional BOPA film segment, holding approximately 20% of the global market and 36% of the domestic Chinese market. Major competitors include Cangzhou Mingzhu, Yuncheng Plastics, Foshan Plastics Technology, Unigic, Xiaoxing Chemical, and A.J. Plast. The company differentiates itself through advanced technology, scale, integrated supply chain, and strong brand recognition.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Sinolong reported revenues of approximately RMB 2.47 billion, a 5.14% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 113 million, reflecting a decline due to pricing pressures and increased R&D investment. The company is in a rapid expansion phase, with ongoing capacity increases domestically and internationally, aiming to reach 215,000 tons annual film production capacity. It maintains strong cash flow and has raised significant capital through its 2024 IPO.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Sinolong offers high-quality, high-barrier, and environmentally friendly biaxially oriented films with superior mechanical and chemical properties. Its vertically integrated production ensures stable supply and cost advantages. The company’s proprietary technologies enable customized, high-performance films for diverse applications including food preservation, pharmaceutical safety, and advanced lithium battery packaging, aligning with global sustainability trends and customer demands for innovation.
